summary: Separate reservation, commitment, allocation and reuse to diagnose fragmentation and asynchronous lifetime failures.
outcomes: Explain allocated versus reserved bytes and fragmentation.
Use a pool or virtual-memory strategy with valid cross-stream lifetimes.
sequence: Draw live buffers, free blocks and allocator reservations.
Separate virtual address reservation from physical backing.
Inspect memory growth and compare a bounded reuse strategy.

visual.question: Why does an allocation fail when total free memory appears sufficient?
visual.interaction: Allocate and release blocks; expose fragmentation and pending users.

practice.task: Diagnose a supplied memory trace and implement bounded buffer reuse.
practice.success: Peak live/reserved memory is explained; no buffer is freed or reused while in flight.
